# WS-DRIFT-SS results (generated by tools/render-results.mjs from results.json; facts only, interpretation in REPORT.md)

Baseline = Phase-2 M155 (Debian chromium-common 155.0.8059.79-1~deb13u1, arm64, ICD sha256 `fa5d1251299c...`). All builds: linux arm64, same Phase-2 images (Node 24.21.0, webgpu 0.6.2 / dawn.node, Ubuntu 24.04 loader 1.3.275) with only `/opt/swiftshader/libvk_swiftshader.so` replaced (overlay images `webgpu-poc-p3-driftss-<cfg>-{dump,full,inv,ex,cts}:arm64`, build-time assertions: .so sha256, aarch64 ELF, no Mesa, no other ICD manifest). Run under 1 slot (2 CPU / 2 GB). Every run asserts backend identity (vendor 0x1ae0 / device 0xc0de / CPU / SwiftShader, no mesa; `backend-assert.txt: RESULT: PASS`).
